title: Finite intersection limits in a finite ind-étale covering
statement: Let $X$ be affine, $U\in\mathcal B_X$ [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis], and $\{V_a\to U\}_{a=1}^m$ a nonempty finite basis covering, indexed by $1\le a\le m$. There exist small nonempty directed sets $J_a$ and presentations $V_a=\varprojlim_{j_a\in J_a}V_{a,j_a}$ by affine étale finite-presentation $U$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra, def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Put $J=\prod_aJ_a$ with coordinatewise ordering. Every $\mathcal V_j=\{V_{a,j_a}\to U\}_a$ is an étale covering, with all members in $\mathcal B_X$. For every $p\ge0$ and ordered tuple $\alpha=(a_0,\ldots,a_p)$, including repetitions, set $T_\alpha=\prod_{r=0}^p{}_U V_{a_r}$ and $T_{\alpha,j}=\prod_{r=0}^p{}_U V_{a_r,j_{a_r}}$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. These are affine ind-étale over $X$, and $T_\alpha\cong\varprojlim_jT_{\alpha,j}$. All transitions are affine; the projections to stages and the limit identifications commute with every projection deleting a factor. No étaleness over $X$ is asserted for the first-limit stages.
